subject: Issue with GSTIN on invoice INV-2526-01472
body:
Dear Sigma Logistics LLP team,

While reconciling our purchases with GSTR-2B we found an issue with invoice INV-2526-01472 dated 30 Sep 2025. The GSTIN on the invoice is 09OSCQD1366A7ZU; its check character is wrong. Our records show the correct GSTIN as 07OSCQD1366A7ZU. Rs 0 of input tax credit depends on this correction. Please provide the correct GSTIN and reissue the invoice.

Regards,
Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
GSTIN 07AAACS1234F1ZU
